item.title: The Woes of Sanitizing SVGs
item.description:
📝 The source of these is that Scratch parses user-generated (ie. 2019: XSS via <script> tag In 2019, a few months after the initial release of Scratch 3, Scratch discovered that SVGs can contain <script> tags that Scratch would cause to be executed when the SVG loads. Surely, with this change, SVGs are now fully safe and will require no further security fixes.
🔗 Read more: https://muffin.ink/blog/scratch-svg-sanitization/

item.title: Show HN: Utilyze – an open source GPU monitoring tool more accurate than nvtop
item.description:
📝 Systalyze is open-sourcing Utilyze, a free, production-ready monitoring and debugging tool that accurately shows how efficiently your GPUs are actually doing useful work, and how close you are to the realistic maximum for your specific workload. They assumed high utilization because their dashboards said so. We’re introducing Utilyze (utlz), a free, open-source tool that fills this gap.
🔗 Read more: https://www.systalyze.com/utilyze
